answer.reason: The verses tell of events that happened at Shechem and to it, beyond its being a city.

clauses.english: was where Joshua gathered the tribes and made a covenant with the people
clauses.quote: Joshua made a covenant with the people that day

clauses.english: was taken by Abimelech, who beat it down and sowed it with salt
clauses.quote: beat down the city, and sowed it with salt

clauses.english: was where all Israel came to make Rehoboam king
clauses.quote: all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king

doubts: Several marked verses (GEN 33:19, JDG 9:28, JDG 9:41, ACT 7:16) use the name Shechem, Sichem or Sychem for Hamor's son, so I did not use them for the city.
Shechem has other events, such as the burial of Joseph's bones, its use as a city of refuge and Jeroboam's building of it, that I left out to keep the line short.
